info.description: Canonical backend routes for experiments, runs, configuration runs, traces and experiment groups. Experiment groups are served only under /api/v1/projects/{project_id}/experiment-groups (API revision W9): opaque group_ref paths, cursor-only paging, search text and filters in POST bodies, closed problem+json denials.

post.summary: Resolve an experiment reference's tenant/project context for cross-workspace deep links
post.description: Moved from GET /api/v1beta/experiments/{experiment_id}/context; the experiment is named by experiment_ref in a closed POST body, so the reference never appears in a URL, log line or error body. Pure read: replay class read, no reservation, fingerprint or replay row. Declared ahead of the Backend (x-asserted-against-backend false): recovery route for SDK/Claude Code deep links of the form .../experiments/view/{id} that open under the wrong tenant. Authenticated but CONTEXT-INDEPENDENT -- excluded from X-Tenant-Id/X-Project-Id requirement and from stale tenant/project context middleware rejection; authentication is still required. Human (JWT/cookie) sessions only: an API-key principal is rejected uniformly before any lookup (403 CONTEXT_RESOLUTION_HUMAN_ONLY), never enumerated against its owner's memberships. The lookup enumerates only the caller's own ACTIVE tenant memberships and, within each tenant, reuses the experiment detail route's real visibility policy (project read role + ownership visibility) rather than re-deriving it; there is no cross-tenant admin bypass -- active membership is required even for platform admins. An experiment that does not exist and one the caller cannot read in any active tenant return the exact same closed 404. The membership probe is bounded (tenant count and wall time); exceeding the bound is a 503, never a false 404 from a silently truncated search. Every response carries Cache-Control: private, no-store.

200.description: The experiment's resolved tenant/project scope, bare (no success/message/data envelope).

401.description: Unauthenticated: no human or API-key session on the request.

403.description: The caller authenticated with an API key rather than a human session; rejected uniformly before any membership lookup.

404.description: The experiment does not exist, or exists but is not visible to the caller in any of their active tenant memberships -- the two are deliberately indistinguishable.

429.description: Rate limited (per authenticated user + IP).

Retry-After.description: Seconds until a retry may succeed.

503.description: The bounded membership probe (tenant count and/or wall-time cap) was exhausted before the lookup could complete. Retryable -- never sent as a false 404 from a silently truncated search.

400.description: Malformed body: one fixed closed shape, never echoing the submitted key, value or reference.

post.description: One cursor page of the project's experiments. POST so the filter vocabulary is a closed body; it is a pure read (replay class read: fresh execution, no reservation, fingerprint or replay row). Replaces GET /api/v1/experiments. Items carry a required experiment_ref; the page is at most 100 items and the response is bounded by the schema's x-max-response-bytes. These are new canonical-operation budgets that the backend window-1b cutover will enforce, not existing backend behaviour.

400.description: Malformed request (closed body; never echoes inputs).

403.description: The project scope or credential does not permit this read.

get.description: Replaces GET /api/v1/experiments/{experiment_id}/export. Bounded metadata export. New canonical-operation budgets that the backend window-1b cutover will enforce (they do not describe existing backend behaviour): a hard ceiling of 50000 rows and 33554432 bytes (32 MiB) of serialized file; over the row ceiling is the closed 413, never a silent truncation. Audited and rate limited as a bulk read.

get.description: Replaces GET /api/v1/traces/experiments/{experiment_id}/graphs. One cursor page, at most 100 graph summaries (hash, element counts and timestamps; no raw graph id, no nodes, edges or loops). New canonical-operation budgets that the backend window-1b cutover will enforce: per-graph element counts follow the backend stored-graph caps (500 nodes, 1000 edges, 100 loops) and the response is bounded by the schema's x-max-response-bytes. The historical experiment id is not returned.

GroupsProblem.description: The closed problem document: every field is the server's fixed text for its code, never built from the request.

detail.const: The request could not be processed.
The credential is not allowed to perform this operation.
The request could not be completed.
The cursor is not valid for this request.
The page size is not valid.

GroupsNotFound.description: Not found or not visible to the caller (identical for absent, hidden and foreign groups)

GroupsValidationFailed.description: The body is not valid (closed problem, nothing echoed)

GroupsServiceUnavailable.description: The service is temporarily unavailable. Retry later (closed problem).

GroupsPayloadTooLarge.description: The request body is over the size cap (closed problem)

GroupsForbidden.description: The credential is not entitled (an expired portal access period); closed problem

GroupsRateLimited.description: Too many requests; closed problem with Retry-After

GroupsInternalError.description: An unhandled failure; closed problem, no detail

GroupsConflict.description: The idempotency key was reused with a different request, or a request with the same key is still in progress (closed problem)
